# HandleGrant

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Copies a handle into another space's handle table.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x08` SVC_MANAGEHANDLE | `MNGHNDL_GRANT (5)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
SvcResult HandleGrant(Handle h, Handle target_space_handle, HandlePerms perms);
```

**Registers:** `(h, target_space, perms) -> r0 status, r1 handle in the target`

The copy keeps the marker of `h`. The receiving space has to learn the new handle's value some other way (by convention, or a message). HandleGrantTo() is the easier form.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `h` | in | [Handle](../types.md#handle) to grant, with PERM_TXFR. |
| `target_space_handle` | in | Space to receive it, with PERM_CNTL. |
| `perms` | in | Permissions for the copy; intersected with those of `h`. |

## Returns

r0 is the status; r1 the handle's value in the target's table.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `h` or `target_space_handle` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `target_space_handle` is not a space. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `target_space_handle` lacks PERM_CNTL, or `h` lacks PERM_TXFR. |
| [`ERR_DEAD`](../errors.md#err_dead) | The target space has been torn down. |
| [`ERR_NOMEM`](../errors.md#err_nomem) | The target's handle table is full. |
